scheme_name: Award Of Incentive For Marriage Between Persons With Benchmark Disabilities & Other Person
description:
The "Award of Incentive for Marriage Between Persons with Benchmark Disabilities and Other Persons" is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India.

This scheme was launched on 15th December 2016.

It aims to promote the social inclusion of persons with benchmark disabilities.

The scheme encourages marriage between persons with disabilities and those without disabilities.

The objective is to provide financial assistance to couples who marry under this scheme.

The financial incentive is intended to help alleviate the economic burden that may arise from such marriages.

The scheme is specifically targeted at persons with disabilities as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016.

This Act recognizes 21 types of disabilities including blindness, low vision, leprosy cured persons, hearing impairment, and mental illness.

The incentive amount provided under this scheme is ₹35,000.

This amount is provided to the couple after they submit the necessary documentation.

The scheme aims to promote the idea that individuals with disabilities can lead fulfilling lives and form families.

The target beneficiaries are individuals with benchmark disabilities who are at least 18 years old.

The scheme encourages the idea of social acceptance and integration of persons with disabilities.

Eligible applicants must provide proof of their disability.

This proof must be in the form of a disability certificate issued by a competent authority.

The application process involves several steps.

First, the couple must fill out the application form which can be obtained from the official website or local government offices.

Next, they must attach the required documents including identity proof, address proof, and the disability certificate.

The completed application form along with the documents must be submitted to the local District Social Welfare Officer.

The application can also be submitted online through the official government portal.

Once the application is received, it will be verified by the concerned authorities.

Verification typically takes about 30 days.

If the application is approved, the incentive amount will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the beneficiaries.

The disbursement is usually completed within 15 days of approval.

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities is the specific agency responsible for this scheme.

The Ministry has established helplines for beneficiaries to inquire about the scheme.

These helplines provide information on the application process and eligibility criteria.

The scheme also aims to raise awareness about the rights of persons with disabilities.

It encourages societal acceptance and reduces stigma associated with disabilities.

The financial incentive is a one-time grant provided to eligible couples.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to empower persons with disabilities in India.

The government has allocated a budget for this scheme under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The scheme is reviewed periodically to assess its impact and effectiveness.

As of the latest reports, thousands of couples have benefited from this initiative.

The scheme is part of the government's commitment to ensuring equality and inclusion for all citizens.

The government also conducts awareness programs to promote this scheme.

These programs are aimed at both urban and rural populations.

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders.

It has been recognized as a step towards building a more inclusive society.

The government encourages NGOs and civil society organizations to promote the scheme.

They are also involved in providing support to couples who wish to apply.

The scheme is aligned with international conventions on the rights of persons with disabilities.

It reflects India's commitment to the United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities.

The government continues to seek ways to improve and expand the benefits of this scheme.

The incentive amount may be revised in future budgets based on feedback and evaluations.

The scheme is a significant step towards enhancing the quality of life for persons with disabilities.

It aims to create an environment where individuals with disabilities can thrive.

The scheme also addresses the economic challenges faced by couples marrying across disability lines.

The government has emphasized the importance of social welfare schemes in achieving inclusive development.

This initiative is one of many aimed at fostering a more equitable society.

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall empowerment of persons with disabilities in India.

The government encourages eligible couples to take advantage of this financial assistance.

The scheme is an important part of the government's broader social welfare agenda.

It is designed to ensure that no one is left behind in the pursuit of a better life.

The initiative reflects a growing recognition of the rights and capabilities of persons with disabilities.

The government continues to monitor the implementation of this scheme closely.

The aim is to ensure that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries effectively.

This scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social justice and equality.

The financial support provided under this scheme is crucial for many couples.

It helps them to start their married life on a more stable financial footing.

The scheme is a vital resource for promoting marriage and family life among persons with disabilities.
